title: Add one completion-driven test launcher with bounded diagnostic output
outcome: Add one completion-driven test launcher with bounded diagnostic output
acceptance: Completion results are durable before notification, notification retry reuses run identity without rerunning tests, and a real root-worker launch survives yielding and wakes the coordinator through genuine inherited TermAl identity; any unsupported path is disclosed.
Final candidate passes required repository validation and independent Codex/Claude review; documentation describes usage without duplicating policy or weakening test requirements.

Full stdout/stderr remains in per-run ignored logs; compact terminal results preserve actual exits, warnings and bounded failure diagnostics with truncation/log locators. Fixtures prove success, failure with unrun stages, warnings, preflight/runner exceptions and truncation; interrupted runs never become PASS.

One maintained entrypoint runs focused commands and every existing required gate in order, with correct tools/configuration preflight and existing input identity checks; no hidden formatting/install/restart.

completion.summary: Delivered the maintained completion-driven test launcher, bounded diagnostics and durable logs/results, genuine worker-to-parent completion wake, notification-only retry, input checks, docs and CI integration. All nine existing gates passed and Codex/Claude review has no actionable findings. Independent evaluator recorded 4/4 pass with judgment basis, not host-attested verification. No new receipt-race test per Greg. No commit, push, install or restart performed.
